pins.head: SQUEEGEE FIRST, THEN PEEL
pins.title: Transfer Tape for Vinyl: Squeegee the Decal Before You Peel
pins.desc: Lay the tape over the weeded decal and press it down with a squeegee from the center out before lifting anything. Peeling too early leaves thin pieces behind on the backing, and they rarely line up again. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A hand lifting a clear sheet of transfer tape over a coral leaf decal, with a cream squeegee on a green cutting mat beside a sunny window and jars on a shelf.

pins.head: KEEP THE CADDY WHERE YOU CLEAN
pins.title: Organize a Small Apartment on a Budget: A Handled Caddy Beats a Cleaning Cabinet
pins.desc: A small apartment rarely has a spare cabinet for cleaning supplies. A handled caddy on top of an open shelf keeps the spray and brushes in one place, and it travels to the room you are cleaning instead of you walking back for each item. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A white cube shelf with coral and teal fabric bins and a row of books, a white cleaning caddy and a small lamp on top, beside a window with a potted plant and a patterned rug.

pins.head: SIZE THE PATCH TO THE SPOT
pins.title: Acne Patches: Measure the Spot Before You Pick a Patch Size
pins.desc: A patch should cover the spot with a small margin, not much more. Hold a ruler to the sheet and note which sizes you actually reach for, then compare boxes by how many of those sizes they contain. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Sheets of clear round hydrocolloid patches in mixed sizes with a clear ruler laid across them on a white counter above a wooden drawer, beside a sheer curtain.

pins.head: PLUG IN ONCE, UNDER THE DESK
pins.sub: Cable Box Below, Clear Desk Above
pins.title: Small Home Office Organization: Keep the Power Strip Under the Desk
pins.desc: Put the power strip in a cable box on the floor under the desk and run one bundle up the back leg. The desktop stays clear for the work itself, and a monitor riser gives the paperwork a shelf of its own. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A wooden desk by a window with a monitor on a riser, a lamp and a potted plant, a white cable box on the floor underneath, and a teal office chair in front.

pins.head: PLATES BELOW, BOWLS ON TOP
pins.title: Expandable Kitchen Shelf Riser: Plates Below, Bowls on Top
pins.desc: Stacking bowls on top of plates means lifting the whole pile to reach the bottom. A shelf riser splits one shelf into two levels, so each stack comes out on its own. This one expands to fit the width of the cabinet. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A small kitchen with an open teal shelf of bowls and mugs above a white shelf riser holding stacked plates, beside a sink, a cutting board and a mesh bag and a towel hanging on the wall.

pins.head: ROLLED TOWELS, NARROW CART
pins.title: Small Bathroom Storage With No Drilling: Rolled Towels on a Narrow Cart
pins.desc: Rolled towels fit the shelves of a slim rolling cart better than folded ones and are easier to pull out one at a time. Park the cart beside the toilet and use a tension-rod shelf above the tank for baskets. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A small white-tiled bathroom with a white rolling cart of rolled teal and white towels beside the toilet, two woven baskets on a shelf under the window, and a wooden vanity.

pins.head: PICK THE GLUE BY THE SURFACE
pins.title: Hot Glue or White Glue: Pick the Adhesive by the Surface
pins.desc: Hot glue grabs in seconds and fills gaps on wood, foam and fabric, but it sits on top of paper and peels off smooth plastic. White glue soaks into paper and card and dries flat. Decide by what you are sticking, not by what is closest. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A cream hot glue gun on a small wooden stand with glue sticks, a squeeze bottle of white glue and a roll of masking tape on a wooden table, with jars of twine on a shelf behind.

pins.head: A POCKET BY THE PILLOW
pins.sub: Bedside Caddy for a Small Bedroom
pins.title: Small Bedroom Organization: A Bedside Pocket Instead of a Bigger Nightstand
pins.desc: A small nightstand fills up fast. A caddy tucked under the mattress edge holds the phone, the glasses case and the book you are reading, so the table top keeps room for a lamp and a mug. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A bed with a teal duvet and coral and teal pillows, an open book on the bed and a gray pocket caddy hanging from the side, next to a wooden nightstand with a lamp and a divided laundry hamper.

pins.head: A REORDER NOTE ON THE SHELF
pins.title: Paper Goods: Clip a Reorder Note to the Shelf
pins.desc: When you open the last pack of paper towels, write it on a note clipped to the shelf edge. By the time the rolls run low, the reorder is already on the list instead of an emergency trip. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Stacked white paper towel rolls on an upper shelf with a blank note clipped to the shelf edge, above folded white towels, beside a linen curtain.

pins.head: COATS UP, SHOES ON THE BENCH
pins.title: Small Entryway for Renters: Coats on Hooks, Shoes on a Bench
pins.desc: In a narrow entry, coats belong on the wall and shoes need one spot the whole household uses. A low bench with baskets underneath holds both the shoes and the things that usually land on the floor by the door. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: An entryway wall with jackets, a scarf and a tote bag on hooks above a low wooden bench with a pair of shoes and two woven baskets underneath, on a patterned rug.

pins.head: SAMPLE THE PODS BEFORE BULK
pins.title: Coffee Pod Variety Pack: Find a Favorite Before You Buy in Bulk
pins.desc: A bulk box of one flavor is only a deal if you still like it at the fortieth cup. A mixed sampler lets you find the pods you actually reach for first, then buy those in the larger pack. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Coffee pods in sage, terracotta and cream stacked beside a plain kraft coffee bag and a calculator on a light wooden counter.

pins.head: SMALL DABS, LESS WASTED PAINT
pins.title: Acrylic Starter Palette: Squeeze Small Dabs and Add More as You Go
pins.desc: Acrylic skins over on the palette within minutes, so a big squeeze mostly dries unused. Put out small dabs of each color and top them up while you work. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A ceramic palette with small dabs of pastel acrylic paint and a flat brush, several white paint tubes on a wooden table, and jars of twine on a shelf behind.
